scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The Kcnq5 conductance, FXYD6–Na+/K+-ATPase regulation, and Coro6 cytoskeletal premise form a defensible hypothesis, with Ano4 and Pcdh8 reasonably treated as subtype markers. However, the claim that electrogenic pump current directly or rate-limitingly determines input resistance is biophysically overstated and would more plausibly operate indirectly through ionic gradients, resting potential, or voltage-dependent conductances.
scores.Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: Fxyd6 was explicitly connected to Kcnq5 through a proposed pump–conductance balance, while low Coro6 was integrated through altered membrane-protein anchoring. Ano4 and Pcdh8 remained largely descriptive subtype markers without explained roles in creating or modifying that mechanism. No formal ceiling was applied because half of the contextual features were integrated and an explicit focus-feature–target mechanism was provided.
